view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, organized warehouse interior with high shelves stocked with boxes. Several forklifts and pallet jacks are parked or in use on a polished concrete floor. Yellow safety barriers and numbered aisle markers are visible. A person in red is seen in the distance near the back entrance. Lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall metal racks filled with stacked cardboard boxes, extending vertically and horizontally across the frame. Located along both sides of the aisle. Some shelves have visible labels like '6' and '7'. No direct contact with floor except at base supports. Partially occluded by forklifts and safety barriers.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Orange and black STILL brand forklift parked on left side of aisle, facing forward. Visible control panel and mast. Partially occluded by adjacent forklift. Resting on concrete floor. No visible attachments or supports beyond wheels and chassis.

objects.label: pallet jack
objects.observation: Metal pallet jack with a beige tarp covering its load, positioned centrally in the aisle. Wheels on polished concrete floor. Partially occluded by other equipment. Appears to be stationary. No visible supports or attachments beyond frame and wheels.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing red jacket walking away from camera down the aisle toward the back entrance. Seen in the far background. Partially occluded by shelving and forklifts. No visible supports or attachments. Appears to be moving.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow cylindrical post with black base, mounted to floor on right side. Connected to horizontal yellow rail. Positioned near warehouse shelving. Appears fixed to ground. Partially occludes view of shelves behind it.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Stacked cardboard boxes on pallets and shelves throughout the warehouse. Boxes vary in size and color. Located on lower shelves and on the floor. Some are partially occluded by equipment. No visible supports or attachments beyond pallets or shelves.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Industrial-style lighting fixtures hanging from the high ceiling. Emitting bright light downward. Distributed across the top of the frame. No visible supports or attachments beyond ceiling mount. Illuminates the entire scene.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32109", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
